y0,y1,x0,x1=290,470,565,750

y,x=np.indices((h,w)); xx=x+x0;yy=y+y0
m=((xx-657)/80)**2+((yy-383)/80)**2<1
ids=np.full((h,w),-1);ids[m]=np.arange(m.sum())
rows=[];cols=[];vals=[];rhs=np.zeros((m.sum(),3));donor=im[y0:y1,x0-170:x1-170]
for y,x in zip(*np.where(m)):
 i=ids[y,x];rows.append(i);cols.append(i);vals.append(4)
 for dy,dx in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:

A=coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)),shape=(m.sum(),m.sum())).tocsr()
sol=spsolve(A,rhs)
bg=im.copy(); bp=p.copy();bp[m]=sol;bg[y0:y1,x0:x1]=bp
